ai_hints: Terraform: resources reachable from the internet, missing encryption/logging/backups, IAM wildcards, replacements that destroy stateful resources (changed names/ids/forces-new attributes), missing lifecycle/prevent_destroy on databases, unpinned provider/module versions, secrets in variables/outputs without sensitive = true, count/for_each changes that reshuffle addresses.

message.es: Una regla/ACL abierta a todos expone el recurso. Restringe a rangos concretos (en egress puede ser aceptable).
message.en: An open-to-all rule/ACL exposes the resource. Restrict to specific ranges (may be acceptable for egress).

message.es: Datos legibles/escribibles por cualquiera. Usa ACL privada y políticas explícitas.
message.en: Data readable/writable by anyone. Use a private ACL and explicit policies.

message.es: Desactivar cifrado o HTTPS expone datos en reposo/tránsito.
message.en: Disabling encryption or HTTPS exposes data at rest/in transit.

message.es: Confirma que debe ser público; si no, usa red privada/endpoints privados.
message.en: Confirm it must be public; otherwise use private networking/endpoints.

message.es: Permisos comodín violan mínimo privilegio. Enumera solo las acciones necesarias.
message.en: Wildcard permissions violate least privilege. List only the needed actions.

message.es: Referenciar una rama hace los planes no reproducibles. Fija un tag o commit.
message.en: Referencing a branch makes plans non-reproducible. Pin a tag or commit.

message.es: Un destroy/replace podría perder datos sin respaldo. Aceptable solo en entornos efímeros.
message.en: A destroy/replace could lose data without backup. Acceptable only in ephemeral environments.
